title: Pulival
desc: Kasi, an employee of a supermarket, steals an expensive phone containing explicit videos belonging to a rich businessman Karthik. Hell breaks loose when the videos get uploaded onto the Internet.

title: Urimai Oonjaladugiradhu
desc: Uma, a young woman, decides to marry James, her lover, against her family's wishes. Her decision leads to the revelation of secrets.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Ramesh joins a businessman's factory to eradicate irregularity and corruption, but gets dismissed due to personal reasons. Later, he is framed for murder when the industrialist dies.

title: Onbathu Roobai Nottu
desc: When an old homeless farmer narrates his tragic life story to a young man who is his friend's son, the two decide to return to the old man's native village.

title: Rajakali Amman
desc: Blessed by Goddess Durga, Meena and her family lead a peaceful life. But the Goddess curses Meena when she decides to marry Ramesh, an evil man.
